effect.name: Radial Blur
effect.description: Blurs outward from a point, or around it. Zoom for a dash or a hit, spin for a dizzy spell or a spinning pickup.
effect.author: CyberMushroom

parameter.name: Centre X
parameter.description: Point the blur radiates from, across the object.

parameter.name: Centre Y
parameter.description: Point the blur radiates from, down the object.

parameter.name: Zoom
parameter.description: Smear toward or away from the centre. Negative pulls inward.

parameter.name: Spin
parameter.description: Smear around the centre instead. Positive and negative spin opposite ways.

parameter.name: Clear Centre
parameter.description: Keeps the middle sharp out to this radius, so a character at the centre of a dash stays readable.

parameter.name: Amount
parameter.description: Blends the blurred result back over the sharp original.
